name: Fashion Valley
description: Fashion Valley is San Diego's premier luxury shopping destination, featuring over 200 retailers including Nordstrom, Neiman Marcus, Bloomingdale's, and an extensive collection of high-end fashion brands. This upscale open-air regional mall in Mission Valley offers an exceptional blend of luxury shopping, fine dining, and entertainment in a beautifully landscaped environment.
demographics: Affluent San Diego residents and visitors, professionals, families, and tourists seeking upscale shopping and dining experiences in Mission Valley
summary: San Diego's premier luxury shopping destination featuring over 200 upscale retailers and dining options in an elegant open-air setting.
